items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: I remember Cliff Clever being the director of Basie's band one time in the Apollo Theater... So he's a very young cat. So he would bring the stick down and we would shoot on with it.

ctx.x: That's hard to explain, but I can quite, I can see what you mean and you can actually hear.
It's a different way, a different approach. But you see, that's what made
Louis to me, so great. He didn't play like any of them. He didn't play Western, he didn't play Eastern. He just played like Louis. And it all came out .........
